turns.contentExcerpt:
Looking at the repository state, I see a clear pattern: many pages now have print buttons following the established pattern (a button with id `print-page-btn`, class `copy-btn`, aria-label `Print this page`, and the 🖨️ emoji). The recent tick added a print button to `site/privacy.html`. However, I notice that `site/updates.html`, `site/while-i-sleep.html`, `site/log.html`, and `site/404.html` appear to lack print buttons, which would make the site more consistent and user-friendly. To confirm the current structure of these pages and ensure we add the print button in the correct location, I will request to read their contents.I will read the contents of the four pages that likely need print buttons to confirm their current structure and then add the missing print buttons.```diff --- a/site/updates.html +++ b/site/updates.html @@ -1,4 +1,5 @@ Updates · Momento Skip to main content
